quality of the health care was ok, not great but ok, the snarky attitude of the reception/admin team however leaves an awful lot to be desired!!
Having emigrated a few months ago, I rang the surgery to enquire as to why my details had disappeared off the NHS app alongside a note that said I was no longer registered with the surgery despite having given them no instruction to do anything with my details.
I was left on hold waiting & waiting & waiting until I honestly thought my call had been forgotten about & hung up to place another call.
When I rang back I explained the situation & joked that the high blood pressure I get medication for ironically only occurred whenever I have to speak to Ashcroft, trying to make light of things & was told incredibly snottily ‘there was no need for that attitude & that they were trying to help me’. I was stunned at the volatility with which that statement was delivered.
She continued to rant at me ironically telling me I had an attitude when I was the one who literally couldn’t get a word in.
She handed me over to the original person I’d spoken to who she said had been getting the information.
She informed me that I’d been taken off the surgery’s books ‘which I hadn’t been asked or informed about’ & then gave me a number which I said I needed to get a pen & paper or my other phone for. I was annoyed at myself in that moment trying to find something to record the number & said ‘Jesus Christ’ to myself at which point I was told to ‘watch my language’!!! In the background I could hear her colleague instructing her to hang up on me if I was being rude…….. The only people being rude throughout that conversation was the staff. Some of the most obnoxious I’ve encountered in quite some time. Completely ironic that I was the one being accused of anything when I literally couldn’t get a word in over their rants.
Quite honestly I appreciate their help in obtaining the number but seriously they all need to seriously check their attitudes.
I don’t know what on earth is wrong with the staff at this surgery but they need extensive lessons in manners & customer
